verses.text: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple say to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth!"
The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth. Ugly, painful sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and who worshipped its statue.
The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea. It turned into blood like the blood of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and the springs of water, and they turned into blood.
Then I heard the angel in charge of the waters say: "You are fair in these judgments, Holy One, you who are and who were.
They poured out the blood of your holy people and your prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve it."
And I heard the altar answer: "Yes, Lord God Almighty, your judgments are true and right."
The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was allowed to burn people with fire.
People were burned by the great heat, and they cursed the name of God, who has power over these disasters. But they refused to turn away from their sins and give him glory.
The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was covered in darkness. People chewed their tongues because of the pain.
They cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, but they still did not turn away from what they had done.
The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates. Its water dried up to make a way ready for the kings from the east.
Then I saw three evil spirits that looked like frogs. They came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
They are spirits of demons that do miracles. They go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.
"Look, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps his clothes ready, so that he will not walk around naked and be seen in his shame."
Then the spirits gathered the kings together at the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, "It is done!"

Then there were flashes of lightning, loud sounds, and thunder, and a huge earthquake. There has never been an earthquake like it since people have lived on the earth. It was that great and that strong.
The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. God remembered Babylon the great, and gave her the cup filled with the wine of his fierce anger.
Every island ran away, and the mountains could not be found.
Huge hailstones, each weighing about thirty-four kilograms, fell from the sky on people. And people cursed God because of the hail, because it was such a terrible disaster.
